essence: The subjugation formula naming the target and commanding control must be written below and on both sides of the designated place.
The syllables gāṃ, gīṃ, gūṃ, gaiṃ, and gauṃ must be written in the sixfold divisions of the filaments.
The Heramba garland mantra consists of gaṃ, namo, and vahnigehinīm.
One should say the words 'giver of accomplishment of all aims' and the phrase relating to all suffering.
The mantra includes the agitation formula twice, followed by hrīṃ, gāṃ, namo, and jvalanagehinī.
